old.name: Lokrum island circuit
old.text: Ferries leave the Old Port every 30 min from 09:00 (Easter to November, 12-min crossing, ~EUR 27 return incl. island entry). Walk: Benedictine monastery ruin → Maximilian's villa + Botanical Garden → Mrtvo More (small salt lake, swimmable) → southern cliffs. Picnic — no restaurants on the island. The Game of Thrones Iron Throne replica sits in the monastery cloister.

calas:Lokrum.brief: Rebuild the old Lokrum walk as an island card (beach labels): the ferry from the Old Port (2026 season: the boat usually stops in November — verify), the Dead Sea lake, the botanical garden, the peacocks, no overnight stays; price 2026.

old.text: Frozen base, microwaved, EUR 18–22 a slice in the touristed mid-Stradun cafés

old.name: "Fresh" oyster claims inside the walls
old.text: Oysters travel 1 h 30 from Mali Ston by road; in shoulder season they may be 3–4 days old

old.name: Truffle products in Dubrovnik
old.text: Truffle is an Istrian product, not a Dubrovnik one — what you find here is imported or oil-flavoured
